entries.reason: The >= 1 guard keeps the Merkle loop running at one digest; odd-length duplication and reduction produce one digest again. Exact-source isolated reproduction: dist/test_vectors.js timed out twice at 20000 ms; the same correct-copy suite passed twice in under 300 ms on this updated test snapshot. Both disposable copies used Stryker's installed disableTypeChecks preparation; the normal unprepared full npm test also passed.
